data.title: Import, export and demo
imp.step1: 1. Choose what to import and the file
imp.hint.products: One row per product. SKU and name are required. Categories, brands and companies are created for you. For a box, give pieces per box and, if you like, box prices and the default sale and purchase unit (box or pcs). Opening stock can be boxes plus pieces with a cost per box, or pieces with a cost per piece.
imp.hint.customers: One row per customer. Name is required. Areas are created for you. An opening due is added to the customer's balance.
imp.hint.dues: Adds an opening due to a customer or supplier that is already in the app. They are found by phone, then by exact name.
imp.utf8: Save from Excel as "CSV UTF-8" so Bangla letters stay correct.
imp.mapHint: The columns of {file} were matched by their headings. Change any that are wrong. * means required.
imp.saveRejects: Save the problem rows as CSV
imp.summary: {total} rows read: {good} are fine and {bad} have a problem.
imp.skipNote: Rows with a problem are skipped. Nothing is half-imported.
imp.truncated: Only the first rows are shown here. The counts above include every row.
imp.dryNote: Press Import to do it for real.
imp.f.name: Name
imp.issue.number: is not an amount in taka
imp.issue.date: is not a real date (use day/month/year)
imp.issue.barcode: has characters a barcode cannot have
imp.issue.minAboveRetail: is higher than the retail price
imp.issue.expiryStock: cannot be entered for a product that expires; buy it in with a purchase instead
imp.issue.phone: is not a Bangladesh mobile number (01XXXXXXXXX)
imp.issue.choice: is not one of the allowed choices
imp.issue.nameOrPhone: needs a name or a phone number
imp.issue.partyNotFound: was not found in the app
imp.issue.partyAmbiguous: matches more than one record; use the phone number
imp.issue.missingColumn: needs a column from the file
imp.issue.sameColumn: uses a column already used for another field
imp.issue.badColumn: points at a column that is not in the file
imp.issue.db.DAY_CLOSED: is in a day that is already closed
exp.title: Export everything
exp.body: Makes one ZIP file with all your business data, so you are never locked in.
exp.inSheets: Spreadsheets for Excel: products, customers, suppliers, sales, purchases and the party ledger, in taka.
exp.inRaw: Every table as stored, one CSV each, with amounts in poisha.
exp.inDb: A full backup you can restore on any PetraDMS.
exp.private: Passwords and PINs are never included.
demo.title: Demo mode
demo.offBody: Fills an empty shop with sample Bangladeshi products, customers, suppliers, sales and payments so you can practise. It is only allowed while the shop has no records of its own. A copy of the empty shop is kept, and clearing the demo brings it back exactly.
demo.onBody: Demo mode is on. Everything you see is sample data. Do not enter real records now; clearing the demo removes everything entered since it was loaded.
demo.cleared: Demo data cleared. Please sign in again.
demo.clearBody: Everything entered since the demo was loaded will be removed and the shop goes back to how it was. You will have to sign in again.
demo.banner: Demo mode: this is sample data, not your real business.
help.title: Help
about.title: About PetraDMS
about.privacy: PetraDMS works fully offline. It never connects to the internet, and it collects and sends nothing. Your data is in the data folder on this computer.
tour.title: Guided tour
tour.invite: New here? Take a two-minute tour of PetraDMS.
tour.welcome.b: This tour shows where things are. Nothing you do in it changes any data. Use the arrow keys or the buttons, and Esc to leave.
tour.sell.b: Make an invoice here. Press F2 anywhere for a new sale, F4 to find a product and F8 for the amount paid.
tour.products.b: Your catalogue, with prices, packs and barcodes. You can also bring products in from a CSV file.
tour.people.b: See who owes what, open a statement and receive a payment with F5.
tour.reports.b: Sales, stock, dues and more. Print them or save as PDF, CSV or Excel.
tour.backup.b: Backups happen by themselves. Set a second folder on a USB drive here so a copy is always away from this PC.
tour.mode.b: Switch between the six big buttons of Simple mode and the complete menu.
tour.help.b: The manual, the shortcut list and this tour are in Help. Press ? anywhere for the shortcuts.
break.ready: Press Space or click to serve.
break.over: Game over. Press Space to play again.
break.won: You cleared the wall. Press Space to play again.
break.help: Move the bat with the left and right arrow keys or the mouse. Space serves. Esc leaves.
break.none: No scores yet. Be the first.
about.gameBody: A quick game of Petra Break. It stays on this computer.
imp.hint.purchases: One row per invoice line: company, invoice number, date, SKU, box, pcs, cost per box and an optional line discount. Rows with the same company and invoice number become one purchase, saved on credit. If one row of an invoice has a problem, that whole invoice is skipped.
imp.issue.boxSize: must be 2 or more pieces per box
imp.issue.sameAsUnit: cannot have the same name as the unit
imp.issue.noQty: needs a box or pcs quantity
imp.issue.noBox: is given but the product has no box
imp.issue.invoiceExists: was already entered for this company
imp.issue.invoiceHasErrors: another row of this invoice has a problem, so the whole invoice is skipped
imp.issue.productNotFound: is not a product in the app
imp.issue.db.DUPLICATE_INVOICE: was already entered for this company
